selectionPurpose: User-authorized 200-model implementation scope for City Library, selected for mechanism diversity and relevance to sustainable cities.

sourceCatalog.method: Extracted all non-empty options from the live Web launcher's select.ss-native in the browser; checked custom dropdown and native disabled counts agree. No desktop repository inventory used.
sourceCatalog.verificationLimits: Inventory and availability flags verified in browser. Individual models were not all loaded or executed. Launch links are constructed from the catalog option paths using the URL convention of the loaded Virus model.

selectionPolicy: Use only browser-catalog entries marked selectable; catalogPath/optionValue are identity, not title or slug.
Read the complete 467-entry selectable list and select deliberately, not by catalog order or random sampling.
Include the five required existing/reference anchors and all eleven Urban Suite models.
Prioritize distinct mechanisms over alternative renderings, perspective demos and repeated elementary-rule variants.

Retain selected variants only for a distinct mechanism: lane changes, goal-directed travel, formation geometry, baseline/intervention epidemics, linear/multilayer learning, Monte Carlo/molecular dynamics and explicit chain topology.
Keep difficult models, including GIS, network extensions, N-body dynamics, molecular forces and neural learning; capability gaps are delivery work, not grounds to fake completion.
Reasons and mechanism tags are selection hypotheses, not a completed source audit. Read pinned Procedures, widgets/reporters/plots, Info and notices before freezing each implementation contract.

Batches are thematic delivery proposals; dependency order is provisional until capability/source audits. Write four or five public asserted examples before each library expansion phase; batch membership does not waive that gate.
No unavailable/deactivated entries or alternative visualizations selected merely to inflate the count. No model implementation was performed by this selection task.

batches.title: Existing anchors and network mechanisms
batches.scope: Audit existing model compositions and establish graph growth, connectivity and directed contagion contracts.
batches.verificationCriteria: Preserve source initialization, graph direction, activation order and terminal rules; verify canonical identities and observation purity.

batches.title: Social learning and collective decisions
batches.scope: Cover individual preferences, opinion transmission, coordination, conflict and cognitive learning.
batches.verificationCriteria: Audit decision timing, information available to agents, tie rules and outcome metrics; verify parameter changes affect canonical state.

batches.title: Markets, allocation and strategic interaction
batches.scope: Model exchanges, financial stocks, strategic location, routing incentives and repeated games.
batches.verificationCriteria: Define ownership of orders, balances and allocations; test conservation where specified, market matching, payoffs and source stopping conditions.

batches.title: Transport, navigation and urban feedback
batches.scope: Deliver distinct transport environments, navigation, adaptive decisions and feedback examples; retain documented behavioral variants only when they add mechanisms.
batches.verificationCriteria: Verify movement boundaries, collision/headway rules, signal timing, trip goals and feedback update order against source contracts.

batches.title: Sustainable urban systems and landscapes
batches.scope: Complete the Urban Suite coverage while connecting city processes to environmental fields and landscape change.
batches.verificationCriteria: Audit each Urban Suite rule independently; verify bounded quantities, environmental coupling, spatial decisions and declared policy measurements.

batches.title: Population ecology and collective movement
batches.scope: Combine population turnover, renewable resources, distributed construction and animal movement.
batches.verificationCriteria: Check birth/death ordering, resource regrowth, population accounting, movement units and isolated random streams.

batches.title: Biological patterns and regulation
batches.scope: Cover morphogenesis, physiological feedback, seasonal processes and local cellular interactions.
batches.verificationCriteria: Verify field update timing, local-neighborhood semantics, feedback response and each source model's observables and bounds.

batches.title: Evolution, inheritance and selection
batches.scope: Span selection, learning interactions, genetic drift and inherited-trait distributions.
batches.verificationCriteria: Audit trait inheritance, mutation/selection order, reproductive sampling and population statistics; avoid inferring biological claims from visual similarity.

batches.title: Epidemics and molecular mechanisms
batches.scope: Cover spatial epidemics, interventions, intracellular processes, immune interaction and gene expression.
batches.verificationCriteria: Verify infection/recovery transitions, control effects, within-cell state ownership, reaction ordering and source metrics.

batches.title: Behavioral ecology and spatial organization
batches.scope: Extend movement, foraging, cooperative decisions and environment-dependent patterning.
batches.verificationCriteria: Audit movement and sensing assumptions, interaction radii, trait/state differences and source-specific aggregation measurements.

batches.title: Lattice fields, thresholds and aggregation
batches.scope: Establish local updates, conservative transport where specified, critical thresholds and growth.
batches.verificationCriteria: Freeze neighborhood/boundary/update-order contracts; test conservation or source-defined loss, stable states and threshold behavior.

batches.title: Kinetic gases and thermodynamic controls
batches.scope: Deliver particle collisions, containers, gas separation and controlled energy/volume changes.
batches.verificationCriteria: Specify particle units, collision handling, boundary interactions and thermal controls; verify source conservation laws within declared tolerances.

batches.title: Continuous mechanics and interacting particles
batches.scope: Cover chaotic motion, force fields, molecular interactions and continuous-time integration.
batches.verificationCriteria: Audit integration method/time step, force laws, singularities, boundaries and numerical tolerances; distinguish source equivalence from scientific validation.

batches.title: Waves, charge and material transport
batches.scope: Combine field oscillation, discrete transport, electromagnetic interactions and material deformation.
batches.verificationCriteria: Specify lattice/continuous mappings, propagation speed, force/charge conventions and field observations; test boundary/reflection and source-specific invariants.

batches.title: Chemical kinetics and transformations
batches.scope: Represent reaction counts, equilibrium, catalysis, polymer formation, acid chemistry and decay.
batches.verificationCriteria: Audit stoichiometry, reaction selection, rates, units and source conservation; ensure changes occur through explicit public model actions.

batches.title: Geometry, pursuit and recursive construction
batches.scope: Broaden spatial contracts through 2D/3D geometry, motion, tessellation and recursive algorithms.
batches.verificationCriteria: Freeze coordinate dimensions, units, transforms and termination depth; test geometric constraints, finite outputs and reproducible recursion.

batches.title: Probability, sampling and nonlinear mathematics
batches.scope: Exercise random distributions, combinatorics, inference from samples and nonlinear iteration.
batches.verificationCriteria: Audit distributions, independence assumptions, sampling units and numerical limits; use analytic expectations only where source assumptions warrant them.

batches.title: Learning, optimization and computational coordination
batches.scope: Cover explicit algorithms with different state, objective and convergence requirements.
batches.verificationCriteria: Freeze algorithm parameters, update order, objective measurements and stopping criteria; verify deterministic fixtures and explicit random streams.

batches.title: Automata and alternative topologies
batches.scope: Span discrete, continuous, stochastic and computational cellular rules without selecting many elementary-rule variants.
batches.verificationCriteria: Freeze cell topology, simultaneous versus sequential updates, boundary behavior and state domains; compare small exact source-rule fixtures.

batches.title: Interactive algorithms and public capability probes
batches.scope: Use distinct games and focused examples to validate interaction, state machines, graph algorithms and geospatial adapters.
batches.verificationCriteria: Audit each game's rules before implementation; test legal/illegal actions, state transitions, graph identity, spatial queries and GIS data/host boundaries.
